Zahra Ke Dar Ka Jo Bhi Hai Darban Ho Gaya.

1
Dunya Mein Faqat Woh Hi Hai Zeeshan Ho Gaya.

2
Darhi Se Saaf Karta Raha Jo Dar-e-Zahra.
Phir Ghoor Se Jo Dekha Tu Salman Ho Gaya.
Aa Kar Qadam Jo Chomay Tu Shabeer Ne Kaha.
Aye Hur Tu Ab Se Sahib-e-Irfan Ho Gaya.
Bughz-e-Ali Wali Mein Jal Raha Hai Gar Koi.
Samjho Ke Oss Ka Dil Hi Shamshan Ho Gaya.
Shab Ko Bhuja Diya Tha Shayad Ke Iss Liye.
Na Chor Ke Jaein Gaye Yeh Eqan Ho Gaya.
Jin Se Khafa Hai Fatima Farman Ho Gayi.
Lanat Ka Hai Haqdar Woh Insan Ho Gaya.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/zahra-ke-dar-ka-jo-bhi-hai-darban-ho-gaya-tajpoints-b91ee20b1072a81ef1a6.md')
old = subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---',2)[2].strip()
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---',2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line.strip() for line in meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()).strip()
assert roman.casefold() == old.replace('.', '').casefold()
assert [len(s.splitlines()) for s in roman.split('\\n\\n')] == [len(s.splitlines()) for s in body.strip().split('\\n\\n')] == [1,2,11]
assert [s.splitlines()[0] for s in body.strip().split('\\n\\n')[1:]] == ['۱','۲']
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified 12 verses, matching Roman wording and stanza structure.')
PY

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions follow the same opening and two-stanza structure. Set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, retained the Roman title as `alternateTitle`, and removed `noUrdu`.

Read “Jaein Gaye” as جائیں گے and retained “Farman” as فرمان in the closing verse.
